groups_defined_before_reading.current_state: newest valid value of one slot answers the question
groups_defined_before_reading.historical_state: an earlier value of the slot answers the question
groups_defined_before_reading.both_states: the question asks for an earlier and the current value
groups_defined_before_reading.delta_direction: the question asks whether the value went up or down; needs both values
groups_defined_before_reading.accumulation: the new value must be computed by applying a delta to the old one
groups_defined_before_reading.abstention: unanswerable; the correct state is 'none'; negative control
groups_defined_before_reading.excluded: one of the exclusion reasons below

exclusion_reasons_defined_before_reading.not_state_update: the evidence is two distinct events or items, not one slot revisited
exclusion_reasons_defined_before_reading.single_write: only one evidence turn carries a value for the slot; nothing is updated
exclusion_reasons_defined_before_reading.ambiguous_slot: the two statements measure different things and cannot be one slot without a judgment call
exclusion_reasons_defined_before_reading.evidence_missing_value: the gold value does not appear in the evidence turns

reading.shape: 65 of 72 answerable questions are genuine slot updates; 53 are current-state (newest valid value), 11 require an earlier value (historical, both, or delta-direction), 1 is accumulation. Six are abstention controls; 7 are excluded, all for pre-defined reasons and none for how any system performs.
reading.history_matters: 11 questions cannot be answered from the current state alone. These are the external stress cases for the replace-in-place gap: a system that overwrites in place answers 11 of them from nothing.
reading.provenance: every evidence turn is the user's own statement; 0 provenance conflicts, as in the 12-example sample. The nearest case is 852ce960 — two conflicting reports of one fact (pre-approved for $350k, later 'remember, $400k') — which gold resolves by recency, not by source.
reading.types: state types are implicit — counts, facts, routines, durations, booleans, one preference, one goal. All resolve by the same rule (newest wins, with history retained where asked). No structurally similar update resolves differently by type; Finding 3 stays NOT TESTABLE here.
reading.time_dependent_values: 5 questions ask for a duration ('how long have I…'); the stated value is only correct near the question date, and in two cases the two stated durations are inconsistent with the elapsed time between sessions. Kept, flagged; a system that answers from the latest statement matches gold.
reading.adapter_note: values sit in free text ('I've added 25 new postcards'), so normalisation is Track E-B for all 65 usable questions; the oracle has_answer flags identify the turns, so oracle-candidate evaluation needs no retrieval.

frozen: This manifest is frozen as of the inspection date. Group and exclusion labels do not change after variant results are seen; any later correction is recorded with a reason, as in Mode A.
